commits.change_summary: compress_into_sink_with_dict uses HashTable4K instead of HashTable8K for inputs >= 64KB (fewer table bits -> different matches -> different compressed output).

commits.subject: Replace check with truncate
commits.perf_evidence: "Replace check with truncate ... Improves unsafe decompression performance ~4% and safe decompression by ~2%"
commits.change_summary: hot loop: an out-of-range match offset is clamped (min / saturating_sub) instead of returning Err(OffsetOutOfBounds) — "we don't return on corrupted data".
